Episode 1
Logline: When a ruthless socialite tries to seize control of her deceased fiancé's empire, she discovers the man sitting in the CEO chair is actually his vengeful secret twin.

SCENE 1 - INT. BOARDROOM - DAY

CAMERA: [00:00.00 - 00:03.00] Close-up of designer high heels clicking sharply against a polished marble floor.
SOUND FX: [00:03.10 - 00:05.00] Sharp, echoing clicks of high heels.
ACTION: [00:05.10 - 00:08.50] Victoria throws a thick stack of merger documents onto the mahogany table.
CAMERA: [00:08.60 - 00:11.50] Close-up of Leo, posing as his twin Julian, sitting calmly in the CEO leather chair.
VICTORIA (Arrogant): [00:11.60 - 00:14.50] "Sign it, Julian. Your family's entire legacy belongs to me now."
ACTION: [00:14.60 - 00:17.50] Leo slowly picks up a luxury gold pen, twirling it between his fingers with a smirk.
LEO (Amused): [00:17.60 - 00:21.00] "You really thought you could bleed my company dry, Victoria?"
CAMERA: [00:21.10 - 00:24.00] Medium tracking shot as Victoria's smug smile instantly vanishes.
VICTORIA (Furious): [00:24.10 - 00:27.50] "How dare you! You're nothing without my family's billions!"
ACTION: [00:27.60 - 00:30.00] Victoria lunges forward and delivers a brutal, stinging slap across his face.
SOUND FX: [00:30.10 - 00:31.50] A loud, echoing slap.
CAMERA: [00:31.60 - 00:35.00] Tight shot on Leo's face. His head is turned, but he slowly looks back at her, his eyes cold as ice.
ACTION: [00:35.10 - 00:38.00] Leo violently grabs Victoria's wrist as she tries to pull away.
SOUND FX: [00:38.10 - 00:39.50] Sharp fabric rustle and Victoria's sudden gasp.
VICTORIA (Startled): [00:39.60 - 00:42.50] "Let me go! Julian, you have never dared to lay a hand on me!"
LEO (Cold): [00:42.60 - 00:46.00] "That is because the Julian you knew was weak. And gullible."
CAMERA: [00:46.10 - 00:49.00] Close-up on Victoria's eyes widening in sudden, panicked confusion.
VICTORIA (Stuttering): [00:49.10 - 00:52.00] "What... what are you talking about? Who are you?"
LEO (Sinister): [00:52.10 - 00:56.50] "Julian died in that fiery car crash you arranged three months ago, dearest."
SOUND FX: [00:56.60 - 00:58.50] Dramatic, low-frequency bass drop.

SCENE 2 - INT. CEO PRIVATE OFFICE - MOMENTS LATER

CAMERA: [00:58.60 - 01:01.50] Wide shot as Leo drags Victoria into his dark, private office and shuts the door.
SOUND FX: [01:01.60 - 01:03.00] Heavy wooden door slamming shut and locking.
ACTION: [01:03.10 - 01:06.00] Leo flings Victoria onto the leather sofa. She scrambles backward in terror.
VICTORIA (Terrified): [01:06.10 - 01:09.50] "You're insane! I'll call the police! They will run your fingerprints!"
CAMERA: [01:09.60 - 01:12.50] Tracking shot as Leo walks slowly toward her, unbuttoning his left cufflink.
ACTION: [01:12.60 - 01:15.50] Leo rolls up his sleeve to reveal a completely flawless, unscarred wrist.
CAMERA: [01:15.60 - 01:18.50] Extreme close-up of his flawless wrist, where the real Julian's famous scar should be.
LEO (Whispering): [01:18.60 - 01:22.00] "Go ahead. Call them. But they won't find Julian's killer..."
ACTION: [01:22.10 - 01:25.50] Leo leans down, gripping her chin tightly, forcing her to look into his eyes.
LEO (Vengeful): [01:25.60 - 01:29.00] "...until I decide to show them the videotape of you cutting his brakes."
CAMERA: [01:29.10 - 01:32.00] Rapid zoom into Victoria's horrified, frozen expression.
SOUND FX: [01:32.10 - 01:35.00] Sudden, chilling orchestral crescendo cutting to silence.
